signes_visibles: “a drink to last” before an outing
not being able to fall asleep without
cooked after humiliation or an argument
drink before an important event (and fail)
shameful hangover + promise not to do it again

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: " I'm terrible. I drink to silence the voice that repeats it to me. ”
combinaisons.declencheur: A humiliation, a failure, a criticism
combinaisons.protege: The heat of shame, the inner court
combinaisons.cout: Shame worsened the next day → cycle
combinaisons.ideal: demerge from the Critic (“it’s a thought, not a fact”)
combinaisons.micro_pas: when the Critic attacks, write the sentence, read it out loud, respond “thank you for protecting” — without drinking
combinaisons.arret: 5-minute reprieve: open nothing, 3 breaths, leave the room

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “No one sees me. Alcohol warms me like a presence. ”
combinaisons.declencheur: The solitude of the evening, the emptiness
combinaisons.protege: The void of existence, the absence of connection
combinaisons.ideal: real co-regulation (a call, a safe place)
combinaisons.micro_pas: a drink replaced by a 5-minute call to ONE safe person, 2 evenings a week
combinaisons.arret: Replace the first drink with a tall glass of water, standing by the window

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I sleep, I no longer think about him/her. ”
combinaisons.protege: The pain of lack, the desire to write
combinaisons.ideal: ritualize evening mourning (write the unsent letter)
combinaisons.micro_pas: instead of glass, 10 lines written, not sent
combinaisons.arret: Call a trusted person before buying

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Without alcohol, I am not able to be myself in public. ”
combinaisons.cout: Social substance dependence; authenticity never tested
combinaisons.ideal: prove to the body that exposure does not kill
combinaisons.micro_pas: A compliment said out loud, without alcohol, to a safe person
combinaisons.arret: Say out loud "I want to drink" — then wait 10 minutes before any move

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I have no right to succeed. I sabotage myself before I can fail. ”
combinaisons.declencheur: The day before an exam, an interview, a chance
combinaisons.protege: Fear of success (and the exposure it entails)
combinaisons.micro_pas: name the part that is sabotaging BEFORE the event, tell them “I see you, I’m in charge”, then prepare soberly
combinaisons.arret: Pour the drink out, then walk outside for 3 minutes

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I can't feel/create without help. My emotions are inaccessible. ”
combinaisons.micro_pas: 5 min of micro-creation (writing, drawing, singing) without substance, “even ugly”
combinaisons.arret: Put the substance out of sight, then walk outside for 3 minutes

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “The world is too strong. I have to disappear for a bit. ”
combinaisons.cout: Life in apnea, no treatment of the cause
combinaisons.micro_pas: protocol 4-7-8 (breathing) instead of the dose, 3 min, + orienting (looking away 60 sec)
combinaisons.arret: Say out loud "I want it" — then wait 10 minutes before any move

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Without boost, I’m not performing well enough. ”
combinaisons.protege: The fear of being overwhelmed, “not enough”
combinaisons.micro_pas: a task 80% completed and validated as sufficient, without incentive
combinaisons.arret: Contact someone before acting (message or call)

signes_visibles: compare your life to other people's posts
virtual identity more invested than real life

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I exist if someone likes me. Each notification is proof of life. »
combinaisons.declencheur: The silence of others, the void of recognition
combinaisons.protege: The nothingness of existence, the absence of mirror
combinaisons.micro_pas: one visible act in reality per day (say hello, show something to someone)
combinaisons.arret: Put the phone in another room, 3 breaths, stand up

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I scroll, I don’t feel the lack. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: the 5 minute rule — when the hand goes to the screen, 5 minutes of breathing first
combinaisons.arret: Replace with 10 squats or a glass of water — the body first

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Everyone succeeds except me. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: instead of the scroll, write ONE real success of the day
combinaisons.arret: Turn off the wifi for 5 minutes and look out the window

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “The real world is dangerous. Online, I am someone. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: one short real outing per week, with a safe person
combinaisons.arret: Set a 5-minute timer BEFORE opening the app

signes_visibles: avoiding real relationships “because porn is enough”

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “My body, my desire cannot stand the gaze. The screen does not judge. »
combinaisons.declencheur: Real sexual desire, the prospect of an encounter
combinaisons.protege: The exposure of desire, the possible humiliation
combinaisons.micro_pas: feel the rise of desire 30 sec WITHOUT taking action, just feel it, name it (“it’s hot here”)
combinaisons.arret: Close the tab, leave the room, wash your hands in cold water

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I will never know how to be loved. The fantasy is enough. »
combinaisons.cout: The capacity for intimacy is unlearned
combinaisons.micro_pas: a hug / a skin-to-skin moment without aiming for the act
combinaisons.arret: Say "I am not in withdrawal, I am missing myself" — then 4-7-8

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I’m a pervert. I have to punish myself. »
combinaisons.protege: Guilt (by feeding it — the system validates itself)
combinaisons.micro_pas: after a relapse, Self said: “It was a survival strategy. I'll start again tomorrow, without hating myself. »
combinaisons.arret: Replace the screen with a notebook: write what is pushing

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Better a landfill than an empty one. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: sit with the vacuum, 2 min timer, “I can hold this vacuum, it won't kill me”
combinaisons.arret: Remember the body is not a proof — then take a shower

signes_visibles: success in the game, failure in life

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “In the game, I am worth something. I win. »
combinaisons.declencheur: The slightest real failure, the slightest criticism
combinaisons.protege: Real helplessness, the feeling of worthlessness
combinaisons.ideal: transfer ONE skill from the game to reality
combinaisons.micro_pas: identify ONE real talent (strategy, perseverance) and apply it to a real 20 min task
combinaisons.arret: Turn off the console, 3 breaths, go outside for 5 minutes

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Online friends don’t go away. Or I can leave them without suffering. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: a weekly real activity with a human (even coffee)
combinaisons.arret: Set a game-end alarm BEFORE starting

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “As long as I play, I don’t have to choose. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: choose a small commitment (appointment, registration) and keep it
combinaisons.arret: Replace one session with a call to someone

signes_visibles: replay after a loss to rebuild

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “The jackpot will make me visible. I will settle everything at once. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: a tiny concrete project (economy, training) which replaces ONE investment
combinaisons.arret: Set a max amount BEFORE opening, remove the card

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I only feel alive when I play. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: intense physical activity (running, sport) instead of a bet
combinaisons.arret: Wait 24 h before any bet — write the possible loss on paper

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I don’t deserve to keep.” I punish myself by losing. »
combinaisons.declencheur: A success, a moment when everything is going well
combinaisons.micro_pas: when the desire to play comes after good news, name it: “it’s the part that fears success”
combinaisons.arret: Ask someone to hold the card for 48 h

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Food is the only love that never leaves. »
combinaisons.protege: The lack of warmth, of connection
combinaisons.micro_pas: before snacking, ask yourself “what am I hungry for?” » — name the need (tenderness, rest, presence)
combinaisons.arret: Put the food down, 3 breaths, ask "what am I filling?"

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If my mouth is full, I don’t feel anything. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: at the first emotional bite, pause 3 min, breathe, “what emotion is there?” »
combinaisons.arret: Drink a glass of water, brush your teeth, leave the kitchen

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “My body is the only territory I control. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: ONE act of body care per day (mindful shower, stretching) unrelated to food
combinaisons.arret: Write the craving on paper instead of acting on it

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I have no right to pleasure. » — so I deprive myself, until the day I break down
combinaisons.declencheur: A moment of joy, a desire, a pleasure that lies ahead
combinaisons.protege: The fault of enjoying, stolen happiness
combinaisons.cout: The deprivation that always ends in overflowing — and the shame that follows
combinaisons.ideal: pleasure without merit or punishment: eating, enjoying, existing
combinaisons.micro_pas: a little chosen pleasure, without spoiling it or paying for it afterwards
combinaisons.arret: when the deprivation becomes more severe: “what am I forbidding myself, and why? »

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I succeed, people won't see that I'm bad. »
combinaisons.declencheur: The slightest downtime, the slightest criticism
combinaisons.micro_pas: 30 minutes of real break per day, without guilt, “I am worth even without producing”
combinaisons.arret: Close the computer at a fixed time, even mid-work

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I work, I don’t have to deal with intimacy. »
combinaisons.ideal: invest the link as much as the project
combinaisons.micro_pas: one non-professional call per week
combinaisons.arret: Say out loud "I am done for today"

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “When I succeed, people will finally love me. »
combinaisons.protege: The quest for love through performance
combinaisons.micro_pas: write down ONE proof every day that we are loved for who we are, not for what we do
combinaisons.arret: Plan ONE real 10-minute break without screen or task

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I stop producing, I no longer exist. »
combinaisons.declencheur: An empty moment, a pause, a silence where no one sees me
combinaisons.protege: The void, the proof to repeat, the existence to deserve
combinaisons.cout: Being exhausted and still so invisible
combinaisons.ideal: exist without producing: “I am here, without doing anything, and it is allowed”
combinaisons.micro_pas: 30 minutes of real break per day, without screen or task — and see it
combinaisons.arret: when the hand searches for a task during an empty moment: 3 breaths, do nothing

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I have to hold on. I must not say anything. » — until the day I collapse
combinaisons.declencheur: A request, a conflict, a personal need to put second
combinaisons.protege: The disappointment of others, the fragile balance
combinaisons.cout: Carry everything, say nothing — and pay with exhaustion that leaves you bedridden
combinaisons.ideal: receive without calculating, ask without trembling
combinaisons.micro_pas: a request for concrete help this week — even if small
combinaisons.arret: when fatigue becomes a way of life: 30 minutes of real guilt-free break

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I work hard enough, I will deserve to exist. » — I never have the right to stop
combinaisons.declencheur: A moment of idleness, a non-productive pleasure
combinaisons.protege: Uselessness, emptiness, the fault of doing nothing
combinaisons.cout: A value indexed to production — and a life that misses out
combinaisons.ideal: exist without producing: idleness as a right, not as a fault
combinaisons.micro_pas: 20 minutes of voluntary idleness per day, without justification
combinaisons.arret: when work calls during a free moment: “do I work, or do I run?” »

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I am wanted, I count. Each conquest is proof of existence. »
combinaisons.declencheur: Self-doubt, the feeling of being transparent
combinaisons.cout: The desire never fulfilled (to prove ≠ to be loved)
combinaisons.ideal: to be seen for who we are, not consumed
combinaisons.micro_pas: AN intimate conversation without any sexual issues, and surviving it
combinaisons.arret: Leave the context, 3 breaths, remember "I am not a proof"

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I will never again be the one who was humiliated. I take it. »
combinaisons.declencheur: Any situation of power, any past rejection
combinaisons.micro_pas: in an interaction, let the other choose and initiate
combinaisons.arret: Replace the act with a cold shower or exercise

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “A body against the void. »
combinaisons.ideal: tolerate the lack without filling it
combinaisons.micro_pas: an evening of solitude without “solution”, 10 minutes of presence with the emotion
combinaisons.arret: Talk to someone about the urge BEFORE acting

signes_visibles: purchases “to please myself” after a hard time

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “What I buy makes me visible. I'm becoming someone. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: before each purchase, 24 hours of waiting + “what am I really buying?” »
combinaisons.arret: Add to the cart then leave the page — come back tomorrow

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I can buy what no one gives me. »
combinaisons.ideal: ask directly what we are missing
combinaisons.micro_pas: express ONE need to a safe person (“I need to be listened to”)
combinaisons.arret: Wait 24 h before any non-essential purchase

signes_visibles: search for thrills in all areas

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I come close to death, I prove that I am not a coward. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: saying “I’m scared” out loud to a safe person — it’s braver than jumping
combinaisons.arret: Delay the act by 1 h — if the urge holds, cut the intensity in half

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I only feel alive in danger. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: 10 min of sensory walking (feeling the ground, air, sounds) every day
combinaisons.arret: Replace with a SAFE strong sensation: running, cold water, music

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I choose danger, it can no longer surprise me. »
combinaisons.protege: The fear of being a victim
combinaisons.micro_pas: leave ONE little thing unplanned per day (choice of meal, route)
combinaisons.arret: Ask "what am I fleeing by seeking myself?" before going out

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I deserve to suffer, but I dare not die. So I brush. »
combinaisons.ideal: the guilt belongs to the child, not the adult
combinaisons.micro_pas: write “I don’t deserve to suffer” 10 times, and read it out loud
combinaisons.arret: Slow down deliberately for 5 min — one road, no speeding

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “The speed is impressive. It gives me stature. »
combinaisons.declencheur: The feeling of being invisible, small
combinaisons.micro_pas: ONE modest, self-recognized real accomplishment per week
combinaisons.arret: Replace speed with loud music and the window open

signes_visibles: push the other to the limit

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “The danger I unleash scares me less than the danger I expect. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: transform A provocation into a question: “What do you feel about me? »
combinaisons.arret: 3 breaths before answering — then "I'll get back to you"

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I swallowed it all. Now I'm exploding. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: express dissatisfaction the same day, cold, in 2 sentences
combinaisons.arret: Leave the conflict scene for 10 min, without your phone

comportements.nom: Relationship drama / unstable relationships / victim-savior-persecutor triangle
signes_visibles: repeated disappointment (“why does this always happen to me”)

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I keep this chaotic relationship going, I’m fixing my childhood. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: stay ONE week in a calm relationship without sabotaging it, noting what it triggers
combinaisons.arret: Name the role before acting: "am I victim, savior or persecutor?"

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Arguments are the only mode of intensity I know. Quiet love bores me. »
combinaisons.protege: The void (intensity as proof of existence)
combinaisons.micro_pas: an entire calm evening, without drama, with a shared presence (film, game, walk)
combinaisons.arret: Refuse a scene: "I'd rather talk about it tomorrow, cold"

comportements.nom: Blocked desire / extinguished libido / fear of finding a partner
signes_visibles: absent desire “I no longer feel anything”
make excuses (“not the time”, “no one would want me”)
flee at the first sign of interest

combinaisons.pompier_note: direct inhibition — no Firefighter, the fire is extinguished upstream
combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “My desire is laughable. To show myself wanting = to be humiliated. »
combinaisons.declencheur: The slightest surge of momentum, the slightest opportunity
combinaisons.cout: Desire dies before it is born
combinaisons.micro_pas: feel the surge of momentum for 30 seconds without doing anything about it, just name it: “there is life there”
combinaisons.arret: A gesture of tenderness with NO goal: a kiss, a resting hand

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I am a head. The body is a foreign object. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: conscious shower 30 sec (feel the water on the skin, without washing mechanically)
combinaisons.arret: Say the need out loud, without turning it into a performance

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “The woman/man devours me, judges me, will leave me. »
combinaisons.protege: The dangerous attachment figure (intrusive mother? rejection?)
combinaisons.micro_pas: a deep non-sexed friendship with the person of the “feared” sex, to defuse fear
combinaisons.arret: Replace avoidance with 10 minutes of body awareness

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Desiring is dirty. Taking pleasure is forbidden. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: allow yourself ONE simple pleasure per day (a good meal, a bath) without guilt — relearn that enjoying is allowed
combinaisons.arret: Name the fear: "I'm afraid of being judged" — then 4-7-8

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I'm not perfect in bed, I'm a lousy man/woman. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: a moment of intimacy without a goal (hug, skin against skin, “we’re not aiming for anything”)
combinaisons.arret: Ground your feet and breathe before concluding "nothing works"

signes_visibles: interest that dies as soon as the other responds

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I am worth what I make others want. Every conquest proves that I exist. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: a meeting where we do NOT seduce, where we simply are ourselves (no jokes, no games)
combinaisons.arret: Ask "do I want it, or am I proving something?"

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I leave first, I will never be left. »
combinaisons.declencheur: The moment when the other becomes attached
combinaisons.micro_pas: stay in a budding relationship after the first impulse to flee, 2 weeks, without disappearing
combinaisons.arret: Stop the seduction in progress: leave or change the subject

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I don't please you, you're nothing. » — seduction as proof, contempt as shield
combinaisons.declencheur: A refusal, a look that doesn't linger, an unfavorable comparison
combinaisons.protege: The humiliation of being desired then disdained
combinaisons.cout: To be loved only for the image, never for yourself
combinaisons.ideal: intimacy without performance: showing oneself without proving
combinaisons.micro_pas: an exchange where you don't try to please - just to be there
combinaisons.arret: when contempt rises after a refusal: “this refusal does not reduce me” — and not responding

signes_visibles: “I am no longer ashamed of my body” (but constantly need to show it)

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Look: I am no longer ashamed. » (but it's shame that leads)
combinaisons.declencheur: Any context where the body could be judged
combinaisons.cout: The gaze of others remains the judge
combinaisons.micro_pas: a whole day without exposure, dressed “for yourself”, and observe what it feels like
combinaisons.arret: Leave the context, 3 breaths, remember "I am not an object"

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If everyone wants me, everyone sees me. »
combinaisons.ideal: to be seen for something other than sexual
combinaisons.micro_pas: reveal a non-sexual skill in public (talk about a subject, show a creation)
combinaisons.arret: Replace exhibition with words: say what you feel

signes_visibles: daily fantasies more real than life

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Fantasy is the only safe place where I matter. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: ONE imperfect (clumsy, true) real exchange per week, without scenario
combinaisons.arret: Close the screen, stand up, ground your feet

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “In my fantasies, no one judges me. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: show an imperfect creation or opinion to a safe person
combinaisons.arret: Name the fantasy out loud — it loses its power

signes_visibles: collapse when the gift is not recognized
withdraw then return with a new donation
“I give without expecting anything” (but every unrecognized gift hurts)

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I only exist because of what I bring. If I don't give, I'm nothing. »
combinaisons.cout: Exhaustion, and never the recognition that fills
combinaisons.micro_pas: a meeting where we bring NOTHING (neither service, nor money, nor advice) and where we remain present
combinaisons.arret: Say NO to a request, even a small one, today

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I save others, I finally save my mother/father. »
combinaisons.ideal: save the inner child, not the adults
combinaisons.micro_pas: 10 minutes per day of inner reparenting (“I’m here, you don’t have to save anyone anymore”)
combinaisons.arret: Receive help without giving back: "thank you" and nothing else

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I give, the other stays. If I stop, they leave me. »
combinaisons.declencheur: The silence of the other, the perceived distance
combinaisons.micro_pas: do not “buy” a presence for a week — and observe if the other still stays
combinaisons.arret: Replace giving with presence: "I'm here, doing nothing"

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I give everything, I save everyone. » — until the final message that I should not have sent
combinaisons.declencheur: One more request, an impossible “no” to say
combinaisons.protege: Debt, ingratitude, the collapse of the bearer
combinaisons.cout: Saving others, dynamiting bridges — and finding yourself alone
combinaisons.ideal: give from the Self, in secret if necessary — and say no cold
combinaisons.micro_pas: say “no” once, coldly, without a long explanation
combinaisons.arret: before sending the final message: 24-hour rule — write, do not send

signes_visibles: then disproportionate explosion or permanent cut-off
astonishment of those around him (“but he hadn’t said anything!”)

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I say what is wrong, I will be rejected or destroyed. I keep quiet, I accumulate, I explode. »
combinaisons.cout: Explosions that destroy what we protected
combinaisons.micro_pas: express ONE dissatisfaction the same day, in 2 sentences, without waiting for the accumulation
combinaisons.arret: Say the upset the same day, cold, in "I" form

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “The conflict is deadly. I prefer to disappear. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: remain present for 2 min in tension without leaking, breathing ventral
combinaisons.arret: Write 3 lines instead of accumulating in silence

signes_visibles: cut ties at the first sign of rejection

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Leave before you are left.” I won't survive another abandonment. »
combinaisons.declencheur: The growing attachment, the slightest rejection
combinaisons.protege: Abandonment (by causing it, we control it)
combinaisons.micro_pas: instead of “it’s finished”, write “I need 48 hours” — and come back
combinaisons.arret: Replace "it's over" with "I need 24 hours"

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I will never be humiliated again. I slice before being sliced. »
combinaisons.declencheur: Any criticism, any injury to self-esteem
combinaisons.micro_pas: respond to criticism with “you hurt my feelings, I’ll get back to you tomorrow” — without cutting
combinaisons.arret: Stay 48 h without deciding, fleeing or threatening

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I hold on, I hold on…and then I suddenly cut it off. »
combinaisons.declencheur: A perceived distance, a sign of anticipated rejection
combinaisons.protege: The agony of waiting to be left
combinaisons.cout: The back and forth that drives the other and oneself — yoyo love
combinaisons.ideal: continued attachment: holding on less tightly, blocking less often
combinaisons.micro_pas: instead of cutting: “I need 48 hours” — and coming back
combinaisons.arret: before sending the breakup message: write, don't send, sleep on it

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: " Everything is fine. » — I didn't say anything, and I already left
combinaisons.declencheur: An unspoken word that grows, an angry truth
combinaisons.protege: The conversation that could break everything
combinaisons.cout: Leaving without having spoken — and leaving the other without explanation
combinaisons.ideal: say it cold, in time, before it boils over
combinaisons.micro_pas: one sentence of truth per week, said coldly, without withdrawing it
combinaisons.arret: before leaving: 24 hours of delay, and one sentence said — even imperfect

signes_visibles: tantrums if the other laughs with someone else

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I don’t watch, someone leaves me. »
combinaisons.declencheur: All attention of the other directed elsewhere
combinaisons.cout: Suffocation of the other → he leaves (prophecy fulfilled)
combinaisons.micro_pas: when jealousy rises, 5 min of breathing + “I am safe, even if he/she laughs with someone”
combinaisons.arret: Say the fear instead of watching: "I'm afraid of losing you"

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “The other one is better than me. I'm going to be replaced. »
combinaisons.micro_pas: note 3 specific qualities per day, independent of the others
combinaisons.arret: Do not check: no phone, no account, for 1 hour

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I don’t watch, he/she will leave. » — and when the fear is too strong, I anesthetize myself
combinaisons.declencheur: A delay, a phone ringing elsewhere, an evening without me
combinaisons.protege: The surprise of abandonment, the fear of being left
combinaisons.cout: Watch day and night — and numb yourself instead of asking
combinaisons.ideal: internal security: asking for proof of love instead of stalking it
combinaisons.micro_pas: a direct request: “I need to know about you — give me some news”
combinaisons.arret: when monitoring starts: 10 minutes without checking, then a direct request

comportements.nom: The clown / jester / make people laugh to be loved
signes_visibles: make fun of yourself before others
“I make people laugh, so they keep me”

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I’m funny, they keep me. If I'm serious, people will see that I'm worthless. »
combinaisons.declencheur: The attention of others, the silences
combinaisons.micro_pas: ONE serious conversation per week, without a single joke, expressing real emotion
combinaisons.arret: Say something true WITHOUT making it a joke

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I control the humiliation by triggering it myself. »
combinaisons.ideal: treat yourself as you would a friend
combinaisons.micro_pas: when self-mockery rises, replace it with a neutral and fair sentence: “I made a mistake, it happens”
combinaisons.arret: Be serious for 5 minutes, no clowning

signes_visibles: push to the limit to see if we stay
“if she can handle it, then it’s true”
surprised when the other one ends up leaving

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If you put up with my worst sides, then your love is true. »
combinaisons.protege: Abandonment (by testing it, we provoke it)
combinaisons.ideal: believe the love that gives itself
combinaisons.micro_pas: a week without any tests, welcoming love as it comes
combinaisons.arret: Answer directly instead of testing: "just ask me"

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I don’t deserve to be happy. I mess up when it gets serious. »
combinaisons.declencheur: The moment when the relationship becomes good
combinaisons.cout: Destroyed relationships on the verge of happiness

combinaisons.arret: Delete the app for 7 days when it becomes a boredom reflex

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I swipe so I don't really commit.”
combinaisons.micro_pas: give ONE conversation a real chance: set a real date within the week
combinaisons.arret: When swiping becomes automatic: close the app and call a friend

comportements.nom: Mental rumination — thought loops about yourself
signes_visibles: unable to let a remark go
endless analysis of your own reactions

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I keep mulling, I'll eventually understand and control it.”
combinaisons.declencheur: A criticism, a failure, an ambiguous interaction
combinaisons.protege: The fear of repeating the mistake
combinaisons.ideal: experience that teaches without a loop
combinaisons.micro_pas: 5 timed minutes of allowed rumination, then write ONE lesson and close it
combinaisons.arret: Say “loop” out loud, stand up, change rooms, 3 minutes

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I don't analyze everything, danger will catch me.”
combinaisons.micro_pas: orienting (look into the distance 60 s) every time the loop restarts
combinaisons.arret: Write the fear on paper, read it, put it in a “deal with tomorrow” box

signes_visibles: unable to leave a worktop non-empty

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Outer order calms the inner chaos.”
combinaisons.cout: A domestic life at the service of anxiety
combinaisons.micro_pas: leave ONE object out of place for 24 h — and survive
combinaisons.arret: When tidying becomes urgent: 4-7-8, then decide if it's a need or an alarm

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “A perfect home proves I'm not worthless.”
combinaisons.micro_pas: invite someone without tidying everything — one area stays “alive”
combinaisons.arret: When the visit is in 1 h: tidy for exactly 10 minutes, then stop

signes_visibles: sabotaging a relationship when it gets serious

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I don't really try, I can't really fail.”
combinaisons.protege: Proof of failure (which would confirm the belief)
combinaisons.micro_pas: send ONE complete application, without rereading it 20 times
combinaisons.arret: When sabotage shows up: tell a safe person “I'm afraid of succeeding (or failing)”

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I don't deserve to make it.”
combinaisons.protege: The guilt of outgrowing your place
combinaisons.micro_pas: accept ONE compliment without destroying it
combinaisons.arret: Say yes to the next opportunity within the hour, before the part finds 10 reasons

signes_visibles: lying awake for hours, mind spinning

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I fall asleep, I drop the watch.”
combinaisons.micro_pas: fixed ritual: warm light, 4-7-8, no screens 30 minutes before
combinaisons.arret: No more than 20 minutes in bed without sleep: get up, read, come back relaxed

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “At night, the voice tells me everything I missed.”
combinaisons.micro_pas: before sleeping: write the Critic's sentence, answer “thanks for protecting”, close the notebook
combinaisons.arret: When waking at night: 3 long breaths + “I'll deal with it tomorrow”

signes_visibles: shame about sleeping + unable to get up

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Bed is the only place where I have nothing to prove.”
combinaisons.declencheur: An emotion, a demand, the morning
combinaisons.cout: A life passing by in sleep
combinaisons.ideal: proving to yourself you can exist awake
combinaisons.micro_pas: wake at a fixed time + 10 minutes of outdoor light, even without wanting to
combinaisons.arret: When the urge to sleep rises during the day: 5 minutes of walking instead of bed

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I sleep, I don't think about him / her / them.”
combinaisons.micro_pas: 10 minutes a day for the missing person (writing, looking at a photo) — the rest of the time, alive
combinaisons.arret: Fixed-time wake-up + a call to someone in the morning

comportements.nom: “Revenge bedtime procrastination” — staying up very late to reclaim your evening
signes_visibles: hating the next morning then starting again

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “My day belongs to others. The night is mine.”
combinaisons.declencheur: The end of a demanding day
combinaisons.ideal: moments of your own during the day
combinaisons.micro_pas: block 30 minutes “for me” during the day (a real break) so you stop stealing the night
combinaisons.arret: “End of evening” alarm 1 h before bed — screens off at that moment

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “At night, I finally decide.”
combinaisons.declencheur: The feeling of having no control over your day
combinaisons.micro_pas: make ONE real decision during the day (menu, route, a no) to soothe the need to take back control
combinaisons.arret: When the fateful hour passes: no “just one episode” — one episode means the whole season

signes_visibles: anxiety if a “forbidden” food is eaten

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “A perfect diet redeems my worth.”
combinaisons.ideal: food as care, not as proof
combinaisons.micro_pas: one “imperfect” meal shared with someone, without commentary
combinaisons.arret: When fear rises in front of a dish: 3 breaths, then eat one bite with someone

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I control what I swallow, the world can't reach me.”
combinaisons.micro_pas: one meal outside the rules, chosen for pleasure, once a week
combinaisons.arret: Talk to a professional about the obsession if the rules keep expanding

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I only keep what I choose.”
combinaisons.declencheur: The feeling of fullness, of losing control
combinaisons.micro_pas: stay at the table 10 minutes after the meal, with someone
combinaisons.arret: Never stay alone after meals — arrange for someone to be there, and talk to a doctor

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “The body must obey.”
combinaisons.ideal: the body's obedience replaced by alliance
combinaisons.micro_pas: say “I can feel without purging” 3 times before the meal
combinaisons.arret: Call an eating-disorder helpline before any act

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Credit gives me the life I deserve now.”
combinaisons.cout: A debt that mortgages the future
combinaisons.ideal: a present life without a mortgage
combinaisons.micro_pas: 24 h of reflection before any credit purchase + write down what it will really cost
combinaisons.arret: Remove credit payment methods from your wallet for 30 days

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I have no leeway, I panic — so I borrow.”
combinaisons.micro_pas: an honest list of debts on paper, without judgment
combinaisons.arret: Consult an over-indebtedness support service if the debt exceeds 3 months of income

signes_visibles: cuts on forearms or thighs, hidden

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “I must pay for what I did / what I am.”
combinaisons.declencheur: A perceived fault, an explosion of guilt
combinaisons.micro_pas: when the urge rises: ice cube on the skin 60 s, elastic band on the wrist, then 4-7-8
combinaisons.arret: A helpline or a safe person BEFORE the act

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Pain proves to me that I exist.”
combinaisons.protege: The feeling of not being real
combinaisons.micro_pas: when emptiness rises: 5 minutes on a gentle sensation (warm water, texture, smell)
combinaisons.arret: Don't stay alone — call or go toward someone, even without explaining

signes_visibles: hitting head or thighs in anger
“I hate myself when I do this”

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Anger at myself is the only anger I'm allowed to express.”
combinaisons.cout: The body pays for the rage
combinaisons.micro_pas: scream into a cushion, hit a pillow 60 s, then write “I'm angry because…”
combinaisons.arret: Get yourself physically safe: leave the room, cold water on the face

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Punishing myself lets me regain control.”
combinaisons.ideal: treating yourself as you would treat a child
combinaisons.micro_pas: talk to yourself as to a friend: “what's wrong? what are you afraid of?”
combinaisons.arret: Remove the objects used for the act + have someone present

comportements.nom: Repeated passive self-endangerment (indifference to your own safety)
signes_visibles: “I don't care what happens to me”

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “If I disappear, it won't matter.”
combinaisons.declencheur: The feeling of not counting for anyone
combinaisons.ideal: treating yourself as someone who counts
combinaisons.micro_pas: one daily precaution (seatbelt, protection, care) while telling yourself “I count”
combinaisons.arret: Talk to a professional about your indifference to your own safety — it's a care emergency

combinaisons.phrase_interieure: “Danger makes me feel alive.”
combinaisons.micro_pas: replace ONE self-endangerment with a sensation activity (sport, cold shower)
combinaisons.arret: When the urge to “tempt fate” rises: call someone and say it
